chunks: Let those who dispute Our signs know that there is no way of escape for them.
ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those who dispute God's signs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the futility of intellectual arrogance when confronting divine truth, emphasizing that those who dispute God's signs are ultimately trapped in their own denial. It serves as a profound warning that despite their eloquent arguments, they possess no escape (mahis) from the consequences of their rejection, reinforcing the concept of divine justice in the Hereafter.
